name: palette-tunnel
prompt: Infinite tunnel effect with a cosine color palette, rotating slowly. Speed slider.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote a shader layer for an endless tunnel coloured with a cosine palette. It rotates slowly, and Speed sets how fast you move forward (default 0.6, range 0–3). Other sliders: Rotate (0.08), Density, Segments and Glow. It hasn't been compiled or rendered because no Powermove tools were attached.
